headline: South Korea October Exports Surge Near-Double in Record Growth Since 1974
summary: South Korea's exports nearly doubled in October, marking the nation's strongest export growth rate since 1974.
why: South Korea is a major global manufacturing center and trade bellwether, making its trade figures a key leading indicator for global industrial and technology demand.

impacts.name: South Korea
impacts.why: Strong export performance signals expanding industrial activity and economic growth.
